title: l1qw.30(c): C deaddrop by-id GET + Observe + read privacy ACL
description: Child of worker6-l1qw.30 (spec 18.9): add by-id GET (deaddrop/<msg-id>), Observe support on the collection GET, and the read privacy ACL to lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c. Landable after (a) establishes the response-code contract.
close_reason: Landed the (c) slice per spec 18.9: (1) by-id GET — new /deaddrop/+ resource (single-level URI wildcard via CONFIG_COAP_URI_WILDCARD, selected by LICHEN_COAP_DEADDROP) with deaddrop_by_id_get extracting the concrete drop id from the request URI path and looking it up through the provider (4.04 conceals existence per spec); (2) the collection GET ?node= query already routes through the provider's node filter (retrieve(buf, len, node)) — by-id now complements it. NOT LANDED here: Observe support on the collection GET — the handler would need RFC 7641 registration/notification plumbing through coap_oscore_send_protected (the same payload-parameter API gap as the Retry-After finding, oscore-bar, bead nqtz); filed as its own follow-up. Also fixed en route: duplicate coap_oscore_authorize_mutating stub in the location host test (main.c:208/263 — kept the richer payload_out variant), and two pre-existing compile breaks in coap_dtn.c surfaced by the DEADDROP-enabled build (stray NULL arg to senml_add_data; wrong REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE code name) — coap_keys overlay DEADDROP build and location_beacon suite now both green (PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL). (a)/(d) prerequisites landed earlier (response-code contract 9488b44e05, storage 3d17292318).
